column1: Hettie|I’ll try not to keep you longer than the hens allow.
Gwil|I’ll watch my step. There’s something I wanted to ask you.
Odo|I’ll keep my voice down. We wouldn’t want to frighten your audience.
Tolan|All right. This can stay between us.
Serjeant Bram|I’m listening, serjeant. I only wanted a word.
Doran|I’ll try to make it a worthwhile moment.
Elder Maddock|Then perhaps you can help me put one down, Maddock.
Pip|You felt them? That gives me a question already.
Mycella|I’ll be careful. Thank you for making time for me.
Bolete|I’d be glad to keep you company for a while.
Truffle|I see them. I’ll be careful where I put my feet.
The Shroom King|Thank you. It’s good to know a question doesn’t need a bow.
Calder|My feet won’t argue with that. Have you time for a few questions?
Prue|Then let’s give your hands a proper rest.
Toft|I’ll do my best to say something the echoes haven’t.
Linna|Let’s compare. There’s always something I haven’t heard.
Wren|A chat, if you have a moment. I might find a question along the way.
Bevan|I’ll keep my elbows to myself. How are things with you?
Isolde|It’s good to see you too. I was hoping we could talk.
Nazim|Then I’m grateful for both. May I stay a moment?
Halima|I’m listening. We needn’t give the wind any more work.
Tarek|I’ll take your advice. You seem less likely to bite.
Suhaila|Thank you for stopping. What are you working on?
Idris|A question first. Perhaps a story will follow it.
Rashida|I’ll keep my sleeves close. I’d like to hear how you’ve been.
Bilal|Your roof is safe from me. I only came to talk.
Sella|Then I hope the pot won’t mind another voice.
Ovid|I’ll speak clearly. I hope I don’t have to compete with the forge.
Jamila|A conversation for now, if that’s all right.
Nerissa|Far enough to know there’s plenty I haven’t seen.
Astrid|Thank you. A little warmth might help me find the words.
Colm|I can stay a moment. What have you been thinking about?
Tessa|Rest your fingers. I’d be glad of a conversation.
Rowan the Hunter|They look as though they’ve earned a rest. How have you been, Rowan?
Sverre|Upright is a good start. I was hoping for a word with you.
Runa|Of course. Supper shouldn’t suffer for my questions.
Eira|A chat would be lovely. How is your day going?
Fenton|Then I’ve arrived at the right moment. I’m listening.
Tallis|No hurry. A good tune can be hard to let go of.
Kip|A few things worth asking about. Small things can be surprising.
Ada|No excuses from Rowan. This visit is my own idea.
Bren|Then we should compare stories. Beginnings can be hard to find.
Berta|My curiosity, mostly. It never seems to stay tended for long.
Della|I’d rather hear it from the person themselves.
Ewan|I’ll try to make it worth marking your page.
Fara|I’ll be careful. I’d like to leave you with company, not a mess.
Garrick|I can manage that. What have you been wanting to talk about?
Hester|That’s a useful talent. I hope my questions won’t tangle the thread.
Junia|Take your time. Some things deserve to be saved carefully.
Kellan|Perhaps we’ll find out while we talk.
Lysa|I’d like that. What has caught your eye?
Cinder|Thank you. A warm welcome is a good place to start.
Warden|I was hoping to stop and hear how things are with you.
Ember|There. A little less of the road on me now. How are you?
Dagna|I’ll wipe them again to be certain. Hello, Dagna.
Lode|Then let’s have our own say before it interrupts again.
Pike|I try to. Nan would ask me the same thing.
Hallow|Good news for the hinge. I was hoping to ask about you as well.
Quarrel|Perhaps we can begin with a pleasantry and work our way up.
Flint|Thank you. I can wait for a quieter crackle.
Winnie|It’s good to see someone who knows Nan. Have you a moment?
Ned|Thanks, Ned. I’ve been meaning to ask you something.
Nan Ferrow|Hello, Nan. I’m glad we have a moment together.
Joss|Then I’m pleased to be a useful excuse.
Osric|I’ll keep them there while we talk, then.
Alder|I won’t hurry either of you. How have you been?
Gwyneth|I’ll try not to quarrel with the scarf over the space.
Bors|I’ll leave the mud outside. The questions can come in, I hope.
Kiln|Then I can ask without worrying about breaking anything.
Petra|A little here and there. I’d like to hear your news too.
Raff|Good advice. It’s easier to listen without squinting.
Suri|A friendly word for now. Thank you for offering both.
Tavin|That would make a very awkward chair. I’ll move over.
Una|Thank you. I was hoping for a moment of your company.
Vela|Then I’ll look and listen. There’s a lot of care in this work.
Wystan|Finish your count. I’d hate to be blamed for a missing coin.
Rania|I’m glad to hear it. I wasn’t winning that prize anyway.
Latif|I’m better at questions than sums, but I can offer those.
Yara|I’ll mind it. The sea sounds like a stubborn neighbor.
Doryn|Then it’s our turn. What have you heard lately?
Bry|So would I. I’ll watch where I’m stepping.
Coral|From inland. I’d like to hear a little about life by the water.
Edda|Thank you. It’s good to have somewhere to stop and talk.
Fennel|There. Just us and the conversation now.
Bjorn|I’d like that. Thank you for making room.
Cap|I’ll stay clear of it. No need to disturb the moss on my account.
Ilsa|I see them. I’ll stand where I won’t undo your work.
Meriel|I’ll look carefully. There’s more in it every time the light changes.
Elin|Perhaps choosing isn’t the most interesting part.
Maelis|All right. I have questions, if you’ll hear them.
Archivist Elowen|I’ve brought a few. It’s comforting to see so many possible answers.
Mira|Looking for one today. Perhaps you can point me toward it.
Oren|Thank you. They’re easier to face with someone listening.
Tamsin|I’m glad of that. Quiet company is still company.
Master Iven|Mostly how much I still have to learn.
Brin|I can look. I can’t promise my eyes know more than yours.
Nell|I’ll keep it low. What sort of subjects do you mean?
Sable|More than one. I’d like to hear how you decide what to believe.
Pella|There’s always another edge to wonder about, isn’t there?
Bess|A moment to talk, if the Copper Cup can spare you.
Ronan|A little cider talk won’t hurt. What else is on your mind?
Venn|Perhaps. I’d like to hear what’s reached you already.
Hobb|Then let me take a turn listening. The table can have a rest.
Edric|A little of both. Talking can help with the planning.
Dorr|We can start with a short one and see how you manage.
Ser Anwen|Thank you. It’s good to be allowed time to find the right words.
Grusk|My hands are clear. I came for a conversation, not your cards.
Fen|Then let’s give them a rest. What’s been happening with you?
Senn|Talking sounds safer. Let’s begin there.
Dain|I’d rather share the news than wager on it.
Rusk|I know the feeling. How has your journey been?
Linnet|I won’t hold a good tune against you.
Puck|The company first, if you don’t mind.
Vale|I’m pleased to meet the person under it.
Cerys|A question. I’m not sure my excuses can be improved.
Nyra|Then I’ll try to make good use of my share.
Maren|Thank you. It’s nice not to have to hurry every word.
Dunstan|I’ll stay back. Have you a moment for a question?
Sela|It does. I can see why people stop to look.
Tam|Your secret is safe. Shall we make the most of the pause?
Celia|Then I’ll try to say something that hasn’t already been copied.
Ivo|A few questions, as usual. I hope I’m not disturbing your order.
Merrin|I’m glad I stopped. How are things with you?
Zella|I’ll stay clear of the cord. Thank you for making room.
Iris|There. A little less cold, and a little more company.
Alderic|Perhaps where I ought to begin. There’s so much I don’t understand.
King Halvard|I have a question, Your Majesty.
Cartwright Oswin|I’ll mind the wheel. A word is all I’m asking for.
Miner Marn|A chance to talk, if you can spare it. I’ll watch my footing.
Miner Nerik|We may yet learn something. That should count as useful.
Snowbuilder Nessa|I think you’re right. What are you making?
Orin|Better for a chance to stop. How about you?
Weft|Take your time. I wouldn’t want to add another knot.
Dorrick|Then let’s give something else a turn.
Hask|Just a conversation. I hope that counts as ordinary.
Garrow|Thanks for stopping, Garrow. I was hoping to ask you something.
Marek|I have a moment. It would be a shame to hurry through it.
Bregga|Then I’ll come closer. The weather needn’t join in.
Torvald|I’d be glad to provide the company, at least.
Ingrid|I’m glad I caught you at a settled moment.
Sigrun|Neither would hurt. Thank you for the welcome.
Asta|Then let’s not leave it unfinished.
Aurelius|There’s always something new to wonder about with you. Where shall we begin?
Edwin|I will keep an eye on the coop while we talk.
